bigreactors:config_condition.why: The three recipe options it reads (registerCharcoalForSmelting, registerCoalForSmelting and registerCoalBlockForSmelting) all default to true.

bigreactors:yellorium_ingot.why: Upstream tags yellorium ingots forge:ingots/uranium, which ProjectE 1.1.0 values at 4096; Item Alchemy gets the same value so both systems agree.

bigreactors:yellorite_ore.why: Yellorite ore drops itself (no Fortune bonus) and smelts into one yellorium ingot, so it is worth one ingot.

bigreactors:cyanite_ingot.why: Reactor waste: burning one yellorium ingot leaves one cyanite ingot. Waste is valued at half its fuel, so two cyanite reprocess (with water) into one blutonium ingot worth a yellorium ingot.

bigreactors:magentite_ingot.why: Reactor waste of blutonium, valued like cyanite at half its fuel.

bigreactors:anglesite_crystal.why: Fortune-boosted gem from End ore veins about as common as nether quartz; valued like quartz.

bigreactors:benitoite_crystal.why: Fortune-boosted gem from Nether ore veins about as common as nether quartz; valued like quartz.

conversions.name: dust
conversions.why: Dusts come from grinding an ingot (Thermal's pulverizer on Forge) and smelt back into one ingot, so a dust is worth its ingot.

conversions.name: fluidizer_bucket
conversions.why: The fluidizer melts one ingot into 1000 mB of its reactant fluid, one bucketful.

conversions.name: verderium_bucket
conversions.why: The fluidizer mixes two yellorium ingots and one blutonium ingot into 2000 mB of verderium.

conversions.name: rossinite_bucket
conversions.why: Reactor waste of verderium, which only exists as a fluid; valued like cyanite and magentite at half its fuel, so four buckets hold half the ingots behind four buckets of verderium.

conversions.name: cryomisi_bucket
conversions.why: The fluidizer mixes one redstone and one snow block into 500 mB of cryomisi.

conversions.name: tangerium_bucket
conversions.why: The fluidizer mixes one anglesite crystal and four ender pearls into 500 mB of tangerium.

conversions.name: redfrigium_bucket
conversions.why: The fluidizer mixes 1000 mB each of cryomisi and tangerium into 2000 mB of redfrigium.

conversions.name: steam_bucket
conversions.why: Reactors and turbines turn water into steam and back one millibucket for one, so steam is worth the water it came from.

conversions.name: reprocess_cyanite
conversions.why: The reprocessor turns two cyanite ingots and 1000 mB of water into one blutonium ingot.

conversions.name: reprocess_blutonium
conversions.why: The reprocessor turns two blutonium ingots and 1000 mB of cyanite into one ludicrite ingot.

conversions.name: reprocess_ludicrite
conversions.why: The reprocessor turns two ludicrite ingots and 1000 mB of magentite into one ridiculite ingot.

conversions.name: reprocess_ridiculite
conversions.why: The reprocessor turns two ridiculite ingots and 1000 mB of rossinite into one inanite ingot.

conversions.name: reprocess_benitoite
conversions.why: The reprocessor turns sixteen benitoite crystals and 2000 mB of rossinite into one insanite ingot.

conversions.name: mekanism_fluid_port
conversions.why: Its recipe only loads with Mekanism: four reinforced casings, two lava and two water buckets (returned empty) around an emerald block.

exclude.bigreactors:*creative*: Creative-only generators that produce steam or water from nothing; they have no survival recipe.
exclude.bigreactors:yellorium_nugget: ProjectE fixes a yellorium ingot at 4096, which nine nuggets cannot split evenly: any nugget value lets crafting ingots into nuggets, or nuggets into ingots, gain EMC.
exclude.bigreactors:anglesite_ore: Drops a Fortune-boosted number of crystals; only the crystals are valued, as ProjectE does for ores.
exclude.bigreactors:benitoite_ore: Drops a Fortune-boosted number of crystals; only the crystals are valued, as ProjectE does for ores.

processes.name: burn_yellorium
processes.why: A reactor burns yellorium fuel into the same amount of cyanite waste.

processes.name: burn_yellorium_fluid
processes.why: A fluid-fuelled reactor burns 1000 mB of yellorium into 1000 mB of cyanite.

processes.name: burn_blutonium
processes.why: A reactor burns blutonium fuel into the same amount of magentite waste.

processes.name: burn_blutonium_fluid
processes.why: A fluid-fuelled reactor burns 1000 mB of blutonium into 1000 mB of magentite.

processes.name: burn_verderium
processes.why: A fluid-fuelled reactor burns 1000 mB of verderium into 1000 mB of rossinite.

processes.name: boil_water
processes.why: An actively cooled reactor boils water into the same amount of steam.

processes.name: condense_steam
processes.why: A turbine condenses the steam it uses back into the same amount of water.
